External state change signal. Usage: /state [description of what changed]

Something outside this session changed. The description is inline.

1. Confirm what you understood changed: "Understood: [one sentence]. Correct?"
2. Wait for the user to confirm or correct.
3. Only after confirmation: update your understanding and proceed.

Do not skip step 2. Do not infer beyond the description. If no description
is provided, stop and ask — the signal without context is incomplete.
